mapper.sql: n.notice_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_level, n.notice_type_id, t.notice_type_name, n.is_top, n.status, n.publish_scope, n.publish_time, n.dept_id, n.create_by, creator.nickname AS create_by_name, n.create_time, n.update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_type t ON t.notice_type_id = n.notice_type_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.user_id = n.create_by
ORDER BY n.is_top DESC, COALESCE(n.publish_time, n.create_time) DESC, n.notice_id DESC

SELECT , n.notice_content FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN sys_notice_type t ON t.notice_type_id = n.notice_type_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.user_id = n.create_by WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_deleted = 0

SELECT , n.notice_content, nu.is_read, nu.read_time FROM sys_notice n INNER JOIN sys_notice_user nu ON nu.notice_id = n.notice_id AND nu.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN sys_notice_type t ON t.notice_type_id = n.notice_type_id LEFT JOIN sys_user creator ON creator.user_id = n.create_by WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.status = 1
SELECT dept_id FROM sys_notice_dept WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY dept_id
SELECT user_id FROM sys_notice_user WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} ORDER BY user_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_notice_user nu INNER JOIN sys_notice n ON n.notice_id = nu.notice_id WHERE nu.user_id = #{userId} AND nu.is_read = 0 AND n.status = 1 AND n.is_deleted = 0
